title: Improved Bloch and Landau constants for meromorphic functions
relevance: Survey paper summarizing the state-of-the-art for B, B_l, L, and B_u. Provides the definitive reference for the chain of inequalities and current best bounds.

title: The univalent Bloch constant problem
relevance: Establishes the current best lower bound B_u > 0.5708858 using an implicit function method based on distortion estimates for univalent functions.

title: On the locally univalent Bloch constant
relevance: Proves B_l > 1/2 + 10^{-335}, which via the chain B_l <= L <= B_u gives a weaker but foundational lower bound on B_u.

title: The univalent Bloch-Landau constant, harmonic symmetry and conformal glueing
relevance: Best known non-trivial upper bound B_u <= 0.6564 using harmonically symmetric arc removal from the disk and Fedorov's Polya-Chebotarev solution.

title: An Extension of Jenkins's Condition for Extremal Domains Associated with the Univalent Bloch-Landau Constant
relevance: Extends Jenkins's necessary condition for extremal domains, constraining the geometry of domains that could achieve B_u. Critical structural result.

title: Distortion theorems for locally univalent Bloch functions
relevance: Sharp distortion theorem for locally univalent Bloch functions. Key technique for deriving covering theorems and lower bounds on B_l and indirectly B_u.

title: Distortion theorems for Bloch functions
relevance: Extends distortion theory to general Bloch functions. Provides the optimal constant in the general Bloch distortion estimate used in lower bound arguments.

title: Local minimality results related to the Bloch and Landau constants
relevance: Proves local minimality of the Ahlfors-Grunsky domain for the Bloch constant and Rademacher domain for the Landau constant. Deep variational analysis.

title: Uber die Blochsche Konstante
relevance: Foundational paper establishing the upper bound for the Bloch constant B using hexagonal lattice domains. Conjectured value remains unproven.

title: On the Bloch-Landau constant for schlicht functions
relevance: First construction of extremal domains for B_u using slit-disk domains. Foundation for all subsequent upper bound work.

title: A criterion associated with the schlicht Bloch constant
relevance: Establishes necessary conditions for extremal domains of B_u using quadratic differential methods. Essential structural constraint.

title: On the Schlicht Bloch Constant II
relevance: Strengthens the 1992 result with additional necessary conditions from variational methods. Further constrains extremal domain geometry.

title: On Bloch's constant
relevance: Best known lower bound for the general Bloch constant B >= sqrt(3)/4 + 2e-4. Technique involves ultrahyperbolic metrics.

title: Uber die Blochsche Konstante und zwei verwandte Weltkonstanten
relevance: Original paper defining the Landau constant and establishing its relationship to the Bloch constant. Historical cornerstone.

title: On the univalent Bloch constant
relevance: Early systematic study of B_u with improved lower bounds and structural analysis of the extremal problem.

title: On the locally univalent Bloch constant
relevance: Improves understanding of B_l with connections to hyperbolic geometry and covering theorems.

title: On a variational problem of Chebotarev in the theory of capacity of plane sets
relevance: Solves the Polya-Chebotarev problem for 4 symmetric points, directly used by Carroll-Ortega-Cerda for the upper bound on B_u.

title: On a Bloch-Landau constant
relevance: Early improved bounds on B_u using refined covering theorems. Historical stepping stone.

title: The Bloch constant A for a schlicht function
relevance: One of the earliest studies of the univalent Bloch constant (denoted A), establishing B_u > 1/2.

title: Sharp distortion estimate for locally schlicht Bloch functions
relevance: Sharp pointwise distortion bounds used in deriving covering theorems for locally univalent Bloch functions.

title: Sharp univalent covering domain for holomorphic self-maps of a disc
relevance: Recent 2024 result on sharp univalent covering domains for bounded holomorphic functions with fixed points. Extends Landau-type theorems.

title: Numeric Computations of Landau's constant
relevance: Very recent 2025 implementation of algorithms for computing Landau's constant. Relevant to numerical approaches for B_u.

title: Les theoremes de M. Valiron sur les fonctions entieres
relevance: Original paper by Bloch proving the existence of a positive Bloch constant. Historical foundation of the entire field.

title: A remark on Bloch's constant for schlicht functions
relevance: Improves lower bound for the schlicht Bloch constant using refined covering arguments.
